notes.title: Holidays Update
notes.content:
Added two types of snow
Audio snow reacts to system sounds
Music snow plays some music

Still working on larger updates and porting to other systems. Merry Christmas everyone!

notes.title: Added laptop mode in settings and something else
notes.content:
Added some optimizations for laptops (you can find it in settings).
I would also like to take this opportunity to congratulate the cats on the completed stage of life. Tomorrow you may notice that they are celebrating.

notes.title: Black screen fix new launch method in steam app settings
notes.content: Added alternative launch method for laptops and probably any who has problems with black screen, try only if you have 2 gpus (integrated and discrete for example)

notes.title: Added back button to creation and import masters, some fixes
notes.content:
Added back button to creation and import masters
(in creation master it will clean all imported frames including rest animations if you back to second step, in import master you can back until 3 step)
Fixed saving window generation acceptable checkbox

notes.title: Fixed some workshop pets bugs, added flipH option to template creation master
notes.content: Fixed workshop and added some functions

notes.title: Windows now always fit screen, even on high scale, scale threshold is now 4
notes.content: Changed some windowing logic. now you can scale your cats as much as you want (it requires recall cat after set scale so they can be as big as you want) and ui will still fit to screen, even on max scale.

notes.title: Changed screen keying method, probably fixed some bugs
